# TSDRVX64.sys ![:inline](/images/twitter_verified.png) 

### Description

Northwave Cyber Security identified TSDRVX64 as a local privilege-escalation vulnerability with a CVSSv3 score of 8.8. Successful exploitation provides kernel-level impact and may enable an attacker to disable security controls or tamper with the operating system.
- **UUID**: 424a387e-735e-49d1-99de-f067dcf1c3e9
- **Created**: 2024-09-11
- **Author**: Northwave Cyber Security
- **Acknowledgement**: Northwave Cyber Security, fluffycats31 | [@fluffycats31](https://twitter.com/@fluffycats31)

{{< button "https://github.com/magicsword-io/LOLDrivers/raw/main/drivers/0412e9fd6ff7d41f599e878b22b8a9b7.bin" "Download" >}}
{{< tip "warning" >}}
This download link contains the vulnerable driver!

{{< /tip >}}

{{< blockbanner "TSDRVX64.sys" >}}
### Commands

```
sc.exe create TSDRVX64 binPath=C:\windows\temp\TSDRVX64.sys type=kernel &amp;&amp; sc.exe start TSDRVX64
```


| Use Case | Privileges | Operating System | 
|:---- | ---- | ---- |
| Elevate privileges | kernel | Windows 10 |
